notes: Auto RePost ka NAYA downloader engine (Android): purani library ki jagah nayi library lag gayi hai — andar naya Python aur yt-dlp 2026 hai, jo aaj kal ki YouTube par chalta hai. Isi liye ye update bari hai (59 MB). Pehli dafa app khulne par naya engine tayyar hone mein thora waqt lagega — ghabrana nahi, ye sirf pehli dafa hoga. Auto RePost wale page par ab downloader ka version bhi dikhega, taake pata chale konsa engine chal raha hai. Apni rukki hui video ke liye watch par 'Abhi post karo' dobara try karein.
